evidence_statement: fpocket pocket candidates, ranks and scores are not binding-site, affinity or druggability evidence (결합 부위·친화도·druggability 증거 아님).
limitations: fpocket pocket candidates, ranks and scores are geometric detector output, not binding-site, affinity or druggability evidence.
Score and Druggability Score are fpocket regression scores min-max normalised across the pockets of the same execution; they are relative within one run and not comparable across runs or structures.
Volume is fpocket's Monte Carlo estimate with a clock-derived seed (seed control unsupported); fresh executions can differ, and it is not an analytical union-of-spheres volume.
Total SASA is fpocket's point-sampled surface of pocket-contacting atoms not covered by the pocket's alpha spheres; it is not whole-protein SASA or the result of the project's SASA tool.
display_center is the arithmetic mean of stored sphere centers computed by ProtView, not an fpocket value.
Coordinates refer to the projected protein-only transport input (standard-residue heavy atoms).

Despite the long option name, this is the minimum number of apolar contact atoms for an alpha sphere to be apolar (help text src/fparams.c:1006-1008).
